youtube.title: It's Not About the Data | $850 Billion Series — Bridge Episode
youtube.description:
People keep asking me about the numbers.

$850 billion lost every year. 19% higher innovation revenue. 60-year-olds outperforming 25-year-olds. United Health. Cisco. BMW. CVS.

The numbers are real. But the data was never the point.

I built Learn More Technologies because I got tired of watching the most experienced people in every room get talked about like a problem to be managed.

The data is the door. It is not the room.

Behind the door is intention, action, invitation, community, independence, and security.

The data is the door. The room is open.

This is the bridge episode of the $850 Billion Cost of Ignoring Experienced Workers series — between Part 3 (What Winning Organizations Do Differently) and Part 4 (The Decision on Your Desk Right Now).

Free Lesson 1: learnmoretechnologies.com/join-now
Workforce consult: learnmoretechnologies.com/workforce

Brian McKinney | Founder, Learn More Technologies | MBE Certified
347+ Pioneers | 3X Completion Rate | 74% Feel More Confident
